newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Turkish markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Turkish markets were closed for the Moslem Eid al-Adha holiday on Monday.
Financial and capital markets will open on April 24, following another one-day national holiday.
Overnight money rates at Thursday's close -- at midday due to the holiday -- were an average 69.93 percent.
Bond market volume was extremely low in pre-holiday trade and the yields were around 94.5 percent at the close on Thursday.
The Turkish lira weakened to 132,600 versus the dollar from 132,460 at Wednesday's close.
